SMTO-SLM-0005 — SMTO's saved SLURM cluster details are incomplete

GUID: 18e46bdc-f215-4de2-91d5-615b86d14af4
Slug: slurm-context-invalid
Domain: SLM · Subsystem: slm

What happened

  • SMTO remembers which SLURM cluster and Gateway each conversation uses. The details it saved for this conversation are incomplete, so it can't use them.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Under the message box, check the Gateways chosen for this prompt. Make sure one of them is the computer that reaches your SLURM cluster. SMTO saves the cluster details together with the Gateway that found them.
  2. Ask the Agent to run sinfo on that Gateway. A successful simple SLURM read saves fresh, complete cluster details for this conversation.
  3. If the error keeps coming back in this conversation, start a new Conversation and run sinfo there. A new conversation starts without the incomplete saved details.

What success looks like

  • The Agent runs sinfo without this error and later SLURM requests show the expected cluster and Gateway.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't submit SLURM jobs relying on the old cluster details until a fresh sinfo works.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The conversation's retained SLURM setup failed validation: it has no Gateway binding, its Gateway identity or route is malformed, or its public setup fields are not exactly cluster, config_ref, cluster_identity and config_revision.

What this means

  • The Controller adapter lacks a setup/Gateway binding or public setup validation finds an unexpected field set. These checks describe local configuration identity and continuity eligibility. They do not query cluster health or prove command rollback; execution and optional observation evidence remain distinct.

Why this can happen

  • The Controller adapter lacks a setup/Gateway binding or public setup validation finds an unexpected field set.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the setup schema and selected Gateway with fresh discovery output.

How to fix it

  • resource_adapters/slurm.validate rejected the stored setup (missing gateway, gateway fields other than node/gateway_id/transport/url, invalid route, or public fields not matching slurm_context.FIELDS). Rediscover by running a read-only SLURM command (sinfo, squeue, scontrol show partition, sdiag) on the intended Gateway in this conversation, and confirm the cluster and Gateway in the new setup.
  • Rediscover the intended SLURM environment on the selected Gateway and review its cluster and partition scope.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A complete valid setup identifies the intended Gateway, cluster and partition scope.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • These checks describe local configuration identity and continuity eligibility. They do not query cluster health or prove command rollback; execution and optional observation evidence remain distinct.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
